_about: Mycelium's weapon prefabs (Resources/<Type>/<name>.prefab), one model and dummy 16x16 texture each, made at build time by the weaponResources task in build.gradle. The item's custom_model_data string is the name in lower case with every run of other characters as one '_' (MycWeapons.modelKey). A weapon not listed keeps its plain bread / beetroot / carrot look.
